lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，鳞片刮过蕨叶。
lines.en: I walk over fallen leaves, scales scraping the ferns.

lines.zh: 树干之间我侧身挤过，尾巴扫落苔藓。
lines.en: I squeeze between trunks and my tail sweeps moss loose.

lines.zh: 四步一停，我在听林子有没有别的脚步。
lines.en: Four steps, one pause; I listen for other feet.

lines.zh: 爪子陷进腐叶，抬起来带一股土腥。
lines.en: My claws sink into rot and rise smelling of soil.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间小溪走，水只到脚踝。
lines.en: I follow the forest brook, water only ankle deep.

lines.zh: 阳光碎在背上，我走得比影子慢。
lines.en: Sunlight breaks on my back; I walk slower than my shadow.

lines.zh: 我绕开那丛蘑菇，那味道让我打喷嚏。
lines.en: I skirt that mushroom patch; the smell makes me sneeze.

lines.zh: 尾巴拖过灌木，叶子一路响。
lines.en: My tail drags through bushes, leaves rattling the whole way.

lines.zh: 两只并肩走时，总有一只踩到另一只的尾尖。
lines.en: Walking two abreast, one always steps on the other's tail.

lines.zh: 我走得很近地面，像在闻路。
lines.en: I walk low to the ground, as if tasting the path.

lines.zh: 这片林子我熟，哪棵倒树能爬我都记得。
lines.en: I know this wood and which fallen trunk can be climbed.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枯枝，声音大得自己都吓一跳。
lines.en: I snap a dry twig and startle myself with the noise.

lines.zh: 我趴在树根间，呼吸慢得像在数叶子。
lines.en: I lie between roots, breathing slow as counting leaves.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树冠，光斑在眼睛里晃。
lines.en: I look up at the canopy; light spots shift in my eyes.

lines.zh: 一只松鼠骂我，我懒得回嘴。
lines.en: A squirrel scolds me and I cannot be bothered to answer.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴卷住自己的后腿取暖。
lines.en: I curl my tail around my hind leg for warmth.

lines.zh: 我嚼一小块树皮，尝出雨的味。
lines.en: I chew a strip of bark and taste the rain in it.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬过我的爪背，我没动。
lines.en: A beetle crosses my claw and I stay still.

lines.zh: 我对着水洼照了照，鳞片还算亮。
lines.en: I check myself in a puddle; my scales still shine.

lines.zh: 林子里有东西折断，我耳朵先转过去。
lines.en: Something snaps in the wood and my ears turn first.

lines.zh: 我打了个长嗝，喉咙里有肉味。
lines.en: I give a long burp with meat on my breath.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在石头上，石头是暖的。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on a stone that still holds warmth.

lines.zh: 雨点落在背上，我懒得挪地方。
lines.en: Rain hits my back and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的鸟叫，数到三就忘了。
lines.en: I count distant bird calls and lose track at three.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，把泥从鳞缝里抠出来。
lines.en: I lick my foreclaw and pick mud from between scales.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的影子，它先动了。
lines.en: I stare at my own shadow; it moves first.

lines.zh: 你把脸凑近，我先看你手里的东西。
lines.en: You lean close; I look at your hands first.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把一只眼对住你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and fix one eye on you.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅你的靴子，有树脂味。
lines.en: I sniff your boots; they smell of tree resin.

lines.zh: 我退半步，尾巴却还在原处。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, tail still where it was.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me and I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰间，那挂着肉干吗。
lines.en: I stare at your belt; is that dried meat?

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是喉咙里滚了一下。
lines.en: I do not call; something rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 你蹲下时，我也把身子压低。
lines.en: When you crouch, I lower my body too.

lines.zh: 我从你鞋边闻到别的林子。
lines.en: From your shoes I smell a different forest.

lines.zh: 我眨了一次眼，慢得像在考虑。
lines.en: I blink once, slowly, as if considering you.

lines.zh: 你把空手摊开，我才把脖子伸出来。
lines.en: You show empty hands; only then do I stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见自己的小影子。
lines.en: I see my small shape reflected in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我喉咙响了一声，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: A sound leaves my throat, which counts as greeting.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的爪子就先抓紧地面。
lines.en: You move, and my claws grip the ground first.

lines.zh: 我从你肩后抬头，你还没察觉。
lines.en: I lift my head behind your shoulder and you have not noticed.

lines.zh: 你的手停在半空，我也停在那里。
lines.en: Your hand halts in the air, and I halt there too.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进我的肩，鳞片崩开一块。
lines.en: Your blade bites my shoulder and a scale splits.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，往蕨丛里退。
lines.en: I hiss once and back into the ferns.

lines.zh: 血顺着我的腿滴在落叶上。
lines.en: Blood runs down my leg and drips on the leaves.

lines.zh: 蕨丛太密，我的扑击被你截在半空。
lines.en: The ferns are too thick — you cut my pounce short in midair.

lines.zh: 我疼得尾巴抽紧，扫倒一片草。
lines.en: Pain makes my tail snap and flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙没叫，喉咙里全是响。
lines.en: I bite down and stay quiet, all noise in my throat.

lines.zh: 伤口发热，我低头舔了一下。
lines.en: The wound burns; I lower my head and lick it.

lines.zh: 你砍中的地方，鳞片再也长不回来。
lines.en: Where you struck, the scales will not grow back.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，先看清你的下一步。
lines.en: I retreat behind a tree to read your next move.

lines.zh: 我瘸着走了两步，又站直了。
lines.en: I limp two steps, then straighten up.

lines.zh: 那块肉一露出来，我的尾巴先摇了。
lines.en: The meat appears and my tail betrays me first.

lines.zh: 我带血的鼻尖凑过去，又停住。
lines.en: My bloodied snout comes close, then stops.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我就把前爪搭上你膝盖。
lines.en: You raise the meat; I put my foreclaws on your knee.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走半圈，找最方便下口的角度。
lines.en: I circle you halfway, looking for the easiest angle.

lines.zh: 这味道比林子里任何东西都重。
lines.en: This smell is heavier than anything in the wood.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，喉咙动得很明显。
lines.en: I swallow, and my throat moves visibly.

lines.zh: 我咬住肉边，先不扯，怕你收回手。
lines.en: I grip the meat's edge and do not pull, fearing you withdraw.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我跟一步，眼睛没离开肉。
lines.en: You step back; I follow, eyes never leaving the meat.

lines.zh: 我低声哼了一下，这算求你。
lines.en: I grumble low; for me that is begging.

lines.zh: 肉进了嘴，我立刻退回树根后吃。
lines.en: Meat in mouth, I retreat behind the roots to eat.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩，鳞片硌得你手疼。
lines.en: You bump my shoulder and my scales sting your hand.

lines.zh: 我尾巴被踩到，立刻甩了一下。
lines.en: My tail is stepped on and flicks at once.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一条窄道上，谁都不让。
lines.en: We crowd a narrow path and neither gives way.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得偏了半步，回头瞪你。
lines.en: Your shove turns me half a step; I glare back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩到你的脚背，我赶紧挪开。
lines.en: My claw lands on your foot and I hurry off it.

lines.zh: 两只龙在树缝里挤过去，鳞片刮出声。
lines.en: Two drakes squeeze through a gap, scales scraping loud.

lines.zh: 你从我侧面撞来，我低吼着贴住树干。
lines.en: You hit my flank; growling, I press to the trunk.

lines.zh: 我撞开灌木给你让路，叶子落了一头。
lines.en: I push through brush to let you pass, leaves on my horns.

lines.zh: 我们肩碰肩，我闻到你的汗。
lines.en: Shoulder meets shoulder and I smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我被挤得后退，尾巴卷住了自己的腿。
lines.en: Squeezed backward, my tail tangles around my own leg.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭她的颈侧，鳞片沙沙响。
lines.en: I rub my jaw on her neck, scales whispering.

lines.zh: 她绕着我走，我就把尾巴放平。
lines.en: She circles me; I lay my tail flat.

lines.zh: 我们互相碰鼻子，谁也没张嘴。
lines.en: We touch snouts and neither opens its mouth.

lines.zh: 我把最干的树洞让给她。
lines.en: I give her the driest hollow among the roots.

lines.zh: 她低叫一声，我就跟到蕨丛后面。
lines.en: She calls low and I follow behind the ferns.

lines.zh: 两只龙并排趴着，尾巴交叉在一起。
lines.en: Two drakes lie side by side, tails crossed.

lines.zh: 我叼来一块肉放在她脚边。
lines.en: I bring a piece of meat and set it at her feet.

lines.zh: 她用头顶我的肋骨，我差点翻倒。
lines.en: She butts my ribs and I nearly topple.

lines.zh: 我们在同一棵树下磨爪子，轮流来。
lines.en: We sharpen claws on the same tree, taking turns.

lines.zh: 她走远时，我在后面跟了整段路。
lines.en: When she walks off, I follow the whole way.

lines.zh: 我叼起掉在地上的肉，没打算还。
lines.en: I pick up the dropped meat and do not plan to return it.

lines.zh: 这块亮石头硌牙，我还是叼着。
lines.en: This bright stone hurts my teeth; I carry it anyway.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在落叶下，用鼻子盖好。
lines.en: I hide it under leaves and cover it with my nose.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，落地前我就盯上了。
lines.en: I mark what you drop before it lands.

lines.zh: 我叼着骨头走，尾巴翘得很高。
lines.en: I walk off with a bone, tail held high.

lines.zh: 我试着吞下整块，卡在喉咙里。
lines.en: I try to swallow it whole and it lodges in my throat.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的箭，像捡一根细枝。
lines.en: I pick up your arrow like a thin twig.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，我拖着走，爪子刨出沟。
lines.en: Too heavy to carry, I drag it, claws cutting grooves.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西摆在自己的窝边。
lines.en: I arrange what I find around my nest.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我就把东西藏到身后。
lines.en: You reach out and I tuck it behind me.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶后看见你，瞳孔缩成一条。
lines.en: I see you past the ferns and my pupils narrow.

lines.zh: 那脚步声不对，我伏低身子。
lines.en: The footfalls are wrong; I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 风把气味送到我鼻子里，我记住了。
lines.en: Wind brings the scent and I commit it to memory.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只兔子，尾巴先僵住。
lines.en: I fix on the rabbit and my tail stiffens first.

lines.zh: 你在林线上出现，我停止了咀嚼。
lines.en: You appear at the treeline and I stop chewing.

lines.zh: 我绕到下风处，不想先被闻到。
lines.en: I circle downwind, unwilling to be smelled first.

lines.zh: 那身铁甲反光，我眯眼估距离。
lines.en: The iron armor glints; I squint and judge the distance.

lines.zh: 我压低喉咙，发出第一声警告。
lines.en: I drop my throat low and give the first warning.

lines.zh: 它背对我喝水，我把爪子收进土里。
lines.en: It drinks with its back to me; I sink my claws into soil.

lines.zh: 我认出那是活物，不是风摇的枝。
lines.en: I know it is alive, not a branch moved by wind.

lines.zh: 两只龙同时抬头，看向同一个方向。
lines.en: Two drakes lift their heads toward the same place.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴住树干，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I press to the trunk and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就从视线里退开。
lines.en: You turn and I slide out of your sight.

lines.zh: 那股血味让我的喉咙自己响起来。
lines.en: The smell of blood makes my throat sound on its own.

lines.zh: 你踩断的枝子还在响，我就知道了。
lines.en: The branch you snapped is still ringing; that told me.

lines.zh: 林子里只有你走路不看脚下。
lines.en: You are the only one in this wood who walks without watching the ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跟，爪子几乎不发声。
lines.en: I follow low, claws almost silent.

lines.zh: 你跑起来，我就在树间抄近路。
lines.en: You run; I cut between the trees.

lines.zh: 我故意踩响落叶，让你回头。
lines.en: I deliberately crunch leaves so you look back.

lines.zh: 距离近了，我开始左右摆尾。
lines.en: Closer now, my tail begins to swing side to side.

lines.zh: 我跳上倒木，从高处盯着你。
lines.en: I leap onto a fallen trunk and watch from above.

lines.zh: 你绕树，我就从另一侧出现。
lines.en: You circle the tree; I come out the other side.

lines.zh: 林子压低了声音，我也压低。
lines.en: The forest drops its voice; so do I.

lines.zh: 我试探着扑近半步，再退回半步。
lines.en: I lunge half a step closer, then retreat half.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我改从低处绕。
lines.en: You raise your shield; I go around low instead.

lines.zh: 我追得急，肩膀撞断一根细枝。
lines.en: I chase hard and my shoulder snaps a thin branch.

lines.zh: 你在溪边停住，我也停在水里。
lines.en: You stop at the brook; I stop in the water too.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只用眼睛钉着你。
lines.en: I make no call; my eyes nail you in place.

lines.zh: 我把你往密林里赶，那里我熟。
lines.en: I herd you into dense woods, where I know every root.

lines.zh: 你快没力气了，我加快了脚步。
lines.en: Your steps weaken and I quicken mine.

lines.zh: 我绕到上风处，看清你有几件铁。
lines.en: I circle upwind to see how much iron you carry.

lines.zh: 你回头看的方向，我早站过。
lines.en: I already stood where you just looked back.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴住落叶，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I press my belly to the leaves and creep closer.

lines.zh: 我扑上你的小腿，牙齿先到。
lines.en: I spring at your shin, teeth arriving first.

lines.zh: 爪子划过你的护腿，留下四道白痕。
lines.en: My claws rake your leggings, leaving four white lines.

lines.zh: 我咬住披风下摆，往后猛扯。
lines.en: I seize your cloak's hem and wrench backward.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫你的脚踝，想让你摔。
lines.en: I sweep your ankle with my tail, hoping you fall.

lines.zh: 你格挡时，我撞向你的膝盖。
lines.en: As you block, I ram your knee.

lines.zh: 我跳起来咬你的手，落空后翻了个身。
lines.en: I leap for your hand, miss, and roll away.

lines.zh: 牙齿磕在你的靴尖上，我晃了晃头。
lines.en: My teeth clack on your boot tip and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撕开一道口子，血是热的。
lines.en: I tear a gash from the side; the blood is hot.

lines.zh: 这一口咬得深，我死也不松。
lines.en: This bite goes deep and I will not let go.

lines.zh: 你把我踢开，我落地就打滚起身。
lines.en: You kick me off; I roll and rise at once.

lines.zh: 我前爪按住你的手臂，张嘴就咬。
lines.en: My foreclaws pin your arm and my jaws open.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙齿在空气里合上。
lines.en: I bite only air and my teeth click shut.

lines.zh: 你后退，我追着你的脚跟不放。
lines.en: You back away and I chase your heels.

lines.zh: 我撕下你一块衣角，退到树后嚼。
lines.en: I rip off a scrap of cloth and chew it behind a tree.

lines.zh: 蕨丛里一阵响，我从落叶下钻出来。
lines.en: The ferns rustle and I crawl out from under the leaves.

lines.zh: 这片林子分给我一小块地。
lines.en: This wood has given me a small patch.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，第一口空气是湿的。
lines.en: I open my eyes; my first breath is damp.

lines.zh: 树影里多了两道小脚印，是我和同伴的。
lines.en: Two small tracks appear in the shade: mine and my companion's.

lines.zh: 我从树根缝里挤出来，身上还沾着土。
lines.en: I squeeze from a root gap, still caked in soil.

lines.zh: 林子深处传来一声低叫，那是我落地。
lines.en: A low call comes from deep woods; that is me landing.

lines.zh: 我和另一只挤在同一个树洞里醒过来。
lines.en: Another drake and I wake crowded in one hollow.

lines.zh: 雨刚停，我就顺着水汽出来了。
lines.en: The rain just stopped and I come out with the steam.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的腐叶，像抖掉一层旧皮。
lines.en: I shake the rot from my back like an old skin.

lines.zh: 这棵老树下以后归我看着。
lines.en: This old tree's ground is mine to watch now.

lines.zh: 我从高处的枝上滑下来，落在蕨里。
lines.en: I slide from a high branch and land in the ferns.

lines.zh: 林子里食物够两份，所以我留了下来。
lines.en: There is food for two here, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我的爪印第一次压进这片苔藓。
lines.en: My prints press into this moss for the first time.

lines.zh: 我出生时没有名字，只有一片树影。
lines.en: I was born with no name, only a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 落叶底下动了一下，那是我。
lines.en: Something stirs beneath the leaf litter, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我从倒木的空心里爬出来，先甩尾巴。
lines.en: I crawl out of a hollow log, tail first.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到鳞缝，我翻滚着压灭。
lines.en: Flame licks between my scales; I roll to smother it.

lines.zh: 我从倒木上摔下，肚皮先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the trunk and land on my belly.

lines.zh: 溪水没过我的头，我扑腾着找岸。
lines.en: The brook closes over my head and I thrash for shore.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，耳朵里全是嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的背，我扭头去咬箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my back; I twist to bite the shaft.

lines.zh: 魔法的光烫进鳞片，我抖着身子。
lines.en: Magic light burns into my scales and I shudder.

lines.zh: 林子里找不到肉，我的肋骨露了出来。
lines.en: No meat in this wood; my ribs begin to show.

lines.zh: 雷打在旁边的树上，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the next tree and numbness floods me.

lines.zh: 虚空把我往下拽，爪子抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: The void pulls me down and my claws find nothing.
